title: Sr. Administrator, Appeals, Appeals
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


At Amazon we believe that every day is still Day One. We are striving to be Earth’s Best Employer and to get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Join the Amazonian eXperience and Technology Departures Team as an Appeal Sr. Administrator and help make a difference for all Amazonians. Our organization delivers best\-in\-class service to Amazon employees and alumni throughout their Appeals journey. As a member of the HR organization, you will handle confidential and sensitive information, as well as demonstrate strong integrity and ethical behaviors. You will use your strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills to bring about continuous improvement on a daily basis; put your exceptional customer service, communication, organizational skills, superior attention to detail and ability to prioritize to work in a fast\-paced, rapidly changing HR environment.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Utilize your deep diving skills and Amazon policy expertise to identify required documentation for appeal cases.  

* Assess documentation for accuracy and past precedent.
* Identify any process defects and recommended remediation.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of human resources experience
* Knowledge of HRIS or Applicant Tracking Systems are preferred
* Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field, or High school or equivalent
* 1\+ years of case management experience
* 3\+ years of contact center, customer service, human resources or equivalent experience
* Demonstrated proficiency handling customer contacts, queries and resolutions.
* 1\+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of human resources functions experience
* Experience with Payroll Systems, HRIS
* 4\+ years of contact center, customer service, human resources or equivalent experience
* Experience using Knowledge database and researching skills.
* Proven ability to manage customer contacts in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proven ability to adjust to constantly changing workloads.
* Proven ability to follow existing process with high attention to detail.
* Additional languages a plus.

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: HR Manager
description:
Job Description – HR Manager

Experience: 3–4 Years

Employment Type \- Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and responsible HR Manager to manage day\-to\-day HR operations, payroll, attendance, leave, recruitment, statutory compliance, and employee relations. The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of Indian labour laws, PF \& ESIC, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to use AI tools to improve HR processes.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Payroll Management

\* Manage monthly payroll processing, including salary, deductions, incentives, and overtime.

\* Verify attendance, leave, late fines, and LOP before salary processing.

\* Coordinate with the Accounts Department for timely salary disbursement.

\* Handle employee salary queries and Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements.

2\. Attendance \& Leave Management

\* Monitor daily attendance, late coming, and absenteeism.

\* Manage leave applications, approvals, and leave records.

\* Ensure compliance with company attendance and leave policies.

\* Maintain accurate attendance and leave MIS reports.

3\. Statutory Compliance – PF \& ESIC

\* Manage monthly PF and ESIC\-related compliance and documentation.

\* Coordinate employee registrations, UAN, ECR, challans, and applicable statutory records.

\* Coordinate with PF/ESIC consultants and government authorities when required.

\* Maintain compliance records and ensure timely completion of applicable filings.

4\. Labour Law \& HR Compliance

\* Maintain practical knowledge of Indian labour laws and applicable employment regulations.

\* Implement HR policies as per company requirements and applicable laws.

\* Maintain employee records, statutory registers, and compliance documentation.

\* Support labour inspections, audits, and compliance\-related queries.

5\. Recruitment \& Hiring

\* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment for various departments.

\* Prepare job descriptions, source candidates, screen resumes, and schedule interviews.

\* Coordinate with HODs for manpower requirements and selection.

\* Manage offer letters, joining formalities, onboarding, and induction.

6\. Employee Relations \& Problem Solving

\* Handle employee grievances and workplace\-related concerns professionally.

\* Resolve HR issues through effective communication and practical solutions.

\* Manage disciplinary actions, warning letters, and policy violations as per company policy.

\* Coordinate with management and HODs to resolve employee\-related problems.

7\. AI Tools \& HR Technology

\* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant HR software to improve HR productivity.

\* Utilize AI for drafting HR communications, job descriptions, HR policies, and reports.

\* Explore AI\-based solutions for recruitment, HR MIS, and process improvement.

\* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company data while using AI tools.

8\. HR Operations \& Reporting

\* Maintain employee files, HRMS records, and HR documentation.

\* Prepare monthly HR MIS covering headcount, attendance, leave, payroll, recruitment, and attrition.

\* Manage employee joining, confirmation, transfer, and exit formalities.

\* Ensure HR policies and procedures are implemented effectively.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

\* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.

\* 3–4 years of relevant experience in HR Operations or HR Management.

\* Strong practical knowledge of payroll, attendance, leave, PF, ESIC, and labour law compliance.

\* Good recruitment and employee relations experience.

\* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.

\* Good knowledge of MS Excel, HRMS, and AI tools.

\* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and documentation skills.

\* Ability to manage multiple HR activities independently.

Preferred Industry Experience: Manufacturing similar industries.

Interested candidates may send their updated resume to:

Email: **hr@kanuniversal.com**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Senior Engagement Associate
description:
**What You'll Do1\. Client \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with NGOs, social enterprises, CSR organizations, and other impact\-sector organizations.
* Act as a key point of contact for assigned organizations and stakeholders.
* Understand client requirements, identify opportunities for collaboration, and ensure timely follow\-ups.
* Conduct client calls, meetings, presentations, and regular check\-ins.

**2\. Recruitment \& Talent Engagement**

* Manage recruitment mandates from understanding job requirements through sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer follow\-up, and onboarding.
* Source relevant candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, OnePurpos' talent pool, and other relevant channels.
* Conduct candidate screening conversations to assess experience, skills, role fit, salary expectations, notice period, and motivation.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Coordinate between clients and candidates to ensure a smooth and timely hiring process.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for frequently hired roles within the impact sector.

**3\. Outreach \& Business Engagement**

* Lead proactive outreach to potential organizations and partners.
* Initiate conversations with decision\-makers, HR teams, founders, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Identify and engage organizations that can benefit from OnePurpos' platform and services.
* Follow up consistently and move conversations from initial outreach to active engagement.
* Build a strong pipeline of prospective organizations through calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other outreach channels.

**4\. Lead Outreach Activities**

* Plan and execute outreach campaigns across calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
* Lead organization\-focused outreach activities and track progress against targets.
* Identify new outreach opportunities and develop strategies to improve response and conversion rates.
* Maintain accurate records of conversations, follow\-ups, and outcomes.

**5\. Events \& Ecosystem Engagement**

* Support and lead outreach for networking events, job fairs, webinars, masterclasses, and other OnePurpos initiatives.
* Coordinate with organizations, recruiters, candidates, and other stakeholders to drive participation.
* Represent OnePurpos professionally at external events, meetings, and ecosystem engagements.
* Build relationships within the social impact ecosystem through events and community engagement.

**6\. Communication \& Relationship Management**

* Draft and deliver professional emails, outreach messages, proposals, and other communication.
* Communicate OnePurpos' value proposition clearly to different stakeholders.
* Handle queries, concerns, and follow\-ups professionally.
* Build long\-term relationships with both clients and candidates.

**7\. Reporting \& Process Improvement**

* Maintain outreach, recruitment, candidate, and client data using CRM, spreadsheets, or other internal tools.
* Track recruitment and outreach performance, conversions, and stakeholder engagement.
* Share regular updates and insights with the team.
* Identify gaps in recruitment and outreach processes and suggest ways to improve efficiency and conversion.
